name: Tomato plate
intro: Thick slices of the best tomatoes of the year, something cool beside them, and a protein on top. The meal July does best.

variations.context: Leftover salmon in big flakes, cucumber yogurt, mint.
No meat. Torn burrata, vinaigrette, basil, sourdough.

finish: Salt the tomatoes first and let them sit while you get everything else ready — five minutes draws out their juice, which becomes the dressing. Flaky salt again at the very end.
